route.mechanism: The feature represents shell mass relative to the larger magnitude of shell or whole mass. My inference is that this may summarize cumulative allocation to calcified shell versus total body mass and let histogram trees threshold that relationship directly. The cited biology paper supports coupled shell deposition, calcification, and organismal growth, but does not establish that this weight ratio predicts rings. OpenFE supports division-based binary feature construction, while the tree paper shows that boosted trees split individual feature axes; neither demonstrates improvement for this task.
